Each registered context root is exactly src/ranex/<context>/.
Every context has one owner, public API, contract projection, and no second semantic home.
Domain/application/port/adapter files match the placement and inward-dependency rules.
Cross-context source imports resolve only through the target context api package.
Actual imports are a subset of registered allowed edges.
The context graph and source import graph are acyclic.
Imports are effect-free and do not perform runtime registration or configuration decisions.
Only bootstrap/composition.py selects and wires concrete product implementations.
Cross-context state propagation uses public APIs or registered integration events/outboxes, never table/repository sharing.
Each table and migration has one context owner; shared persistence mechanics own no domain schema.
Every production owner has tests in an ADR-0008 allowed root with matching context/layer metadata.
Schemas and generated artifacts have one semantic source, generator/input digests, and zero hand-edit drift.
Context migrations are owner-local and cross-context ordering is explicit, tested, and reversible.
Only the compatibility boundary imports inherited/legacy roots; new Ranex packages never do.
Every governed path resolves to one CODEOWNERS-ready semantic owner and required reviewer.
Package/module discovery is manifest-driven, side-effect-free, and excludes tests/docs/tools/legacy.
Context README and registry links make owner, API, invariants, data, dependencies, operations, and tests findable.
Every topology exception is exact-path, exact-rule, owned, justified, time-bounded, and non-transitive.
Each implementation change binds RED, GREEN, REFACTOR and architecture-check evidence or a valid exception.
Tests execute production domain/application/authority/policy/schema/migration code with no test-only business branch or weakened control.
Gate-bearing lanes test one content-digested candidate artifact and release profile.
Nondeterminism/external effects enter only through declared ports with recorded controls, and every fake has parity plus representative real-adapter evidence.
Persistence evidence uses ephemeral real SQLite, production migrations and the production UoW.
Every test resides in an allowed root and resolves to one context/capability owner, lane and exact subject.
Every capability has a complete versioned applicability/result row for each required failure-mode category.
Closed state/command/gate/effect registries have exhaustive legal and illegal transition-pair coverage.
Open input spaces declare properties/partitions and reproducible property/model/fuzz/mutation/fault evidence plus remaining unknowns.
Fixtures/builders have one owner, provenance/classification/version, deterministic semantics and no duplicate business rule.
Retries/quarantine never manufacture PASS; every quarantine is owned, expiring and preserves material UNKNOWN/blocking status.
Generated-code exceptions bind generator/schema/golden/compatibility/drift tests and prohibit hand edits.
Migration/replay evidence covers forward/backward/rollback/crash/corruption/version/digest repeatability on production code.
Test data satisfies classification, minimization, provenance, secret, access, retention and deletion policy.
Risk/release policy schedules every required lane against the same subject; slow scheduling cannot waive it.
Risk-selected critical logic receives mutation/negative assertion-strength evidence with survivor disposition.
Test paths emit production-equivalent structured observability with explicit test subject/profile identity.
Proxy scores cannot compensate for missing, failed, stale, flaky or UNKNOWN required evidence.
Every TDD exception is typed, exact-scope, owned, risk-assessed, alternative-evidenced, expiring and backfilled.

Every allowed cross-context source dependency is one exact owned public-api edge with interaction, consistency, failure, and recovery semantics.
Actual cross-context imports are a subset of approved edges and target only the callee api package.
Declared and actual context dependency graphs are acyclic; missing or ambiguous edge identity blocks.
Every registered context has exactly one boundary-fit row with all hypothesis, alternative, owner, and falsifier fields.
A fired falsifier or material unknown blocks a mature/proven boundary claim until an owned keep, merge, or split decision.
governed_execution responsibility, fan-in, fan-out, interaction, change, and ownership-concentration distributions are exact-subject measured at the declared cadence.
A coupling trigger creates independent boundary review and cannot be dismissed by an average or central-authority necessity.
Fast-loop and pre-verification latency distributions bind the declared host, artifact, manifest, window, owner, and cadence.
Selection, sharding, caching, and escalation are deterministic, recorded, risk-aware, and cannot omit a required lane.
No boundary, coupling, or feedback metric compensates for another failed, stale, missing, or unknown obligation.
Exact edge registry has unique known owners/pairs, complete semantics, and no unapproved/default edge.
Static import graph proves public-API-only actual ⊆ declared, no cycles, and no private/adapter/legacy leak.
Boundary registry has exactly the 34 canonical context IDs and every required fit field.
Representative tracers attempt each applicable falsifier and bind keep/merge/split disposition without claiming exhaustive proof.
Exact-subject static and rolling runtime/change distributions compute all six governed-execution measures.
Threshold fixtures prove every trigger creates a blocking review record and no average suppresses it.
Thirty-candidate reference-host distributions compute all four latency objectives without excluding failures/timeouts.
Repeated generation produces identical selection/shards; changed dependency/risk/failure fixtures escalate and never reduce lanes.
A fixture with excellent latency/low coupling plus one failed/unknown rule remains nonsealing.
